_comment: Pre-change backup of the single combined Dash app (dashboards/app.py, dashboard_data.py) captured before the Section 7 refactor. The mode radio switched all five panels between Raw (energy_readings) and Aggregate (Section 6.1 continuous aggregates). No secrets are present. Source .py files are copied alongside as *.py.bak.

panels.title: Hourly regional energy (kWh)
panels.raw_sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ %s) AS bucket, m.region AS region, sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh FROM energy_readings r JOIN meters m USING (meter_id) WHERE r.event_time >= %s::timestamptz AND r.event_time < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY bucket, m.region ORDER BY bucket, m.region
panels.agg_sql: SELECT bucket, region, sum(sum_energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh FROM cagg_hour_region WHERE bucket >= %s::timestamptz AND bucket < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY bucket, region ORDER BY bucket, region

panels.title: Daily network energy (kWh)
panels.raw_sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ %s) AS bucket, sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh FROM energy_readings r WHERE r.event_time >= %s::timestamptz AND r.event_time < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
panels.agg_sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', bucket, TIMESTAMPTZ %s) AS bucket, sum(sum_energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh FROM cagg_15min_region WHERE bucket >= %s::timestamptz AND bucket < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Network energy in Section 5.1 seven-day periods (kWh)
panels.raw_sql: per-period loop: SELECT sum(r.energy_kwh) FROM energy_readings r WHERE r.event_time >= GREATEST(%s::timestamptz,%s::timestamptz) AND r.event_time < LEAST(%s::timestamptz,%s::timestamptz)
panels.agg_sql: per-period loop: SELECT sum(sum_energy_kwh) FROM cagg_15min_region WHERE bucket >= GREATEST(%s::timestamptz,%s::timestamptz) AND bucket < LEAST(%s::timestamptz,%s::timestamptz)

panels.title: Daily energy of selected meter (kWh)
panels.raw_sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', r.event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ %s) AS bucket, sum(r.energy_kwh) AS energy_kwh FROM energy_readings r WHERE r.meter_id = %s AND r.event_time >= %s::timestamptz AND r.event_time < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
panels.agg_sql: SELECT bucket, sum_energy_kwh AS energy_kwh FROM cagg_day_meter WHERE meter_id = %s AND bucket >= %s::timestamptz AND bucket < %s::timestamptz ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Completeness by region (%)
panels.raw_sql: SELECT m.region, count(DISTINCT (r.meter_id, r.event_time)) AS observed FROM energy_readings r JOIN meters m USING (meter_id) WHERE r.event_time >= %s::timestamptz AND r.event_time < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY m.region
panels.agg_sql: SELECT region, sum(reading_count) AS observed FROM cagg_15min_region WHERE bucket >= %s::timestamptz AND bucket < %s::timestamptz GROUP BY region
panels.note: Pre-change Raw used count(DISTINCT (meter_id, event_time)); requirement 7.1 says count(*) of cleaned rows.
